description: Computes a pre-checkout cost estimate for a given merchant, destination ZIP, and list of items. Returns subtotal, shipping, tax, and total (with shippingKnown / taxKnown flags) before placing an order. unitPrice can be taken from get_product_details or search_products.

destination.description: Delivery destination for shipping and tax calculation

items.description: List of items to estimate costs for

merchant.description: Name of the merchant to estimate costs for (e.g. 'Alo Yoga')

name: get_checkout_estimates
